name: Blog AI summarize
author: auto-post.io

sections.description:
Blog AI summarize is a WordPress plugin that adds a customizable block to single posts, allowing readers to quickly summarize articles using various AI services.

Features

  • Add AI summarization links to single posts
  • Support for multiple AI services: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Mistral, HuggingChat, You.com, Grok
  • Customizable title text
  • Enable/disable individual AI services
  • Choose display position: top, bottom, or both
  • Customizable colors: background, primary, and secondary colors
  • Responsive design
  • Dark and light theme support

AI services supported

  • ChatGPT (OpenAI)
  • Perplexity
  • Mistral
  • HuggingChat
  • You.com
  • Grok (xAI)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/blog-ai-summarize directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Appearance > Customize > AI Summarize to configure the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an API key?

No, this plugin uses direct links to AI chat services. No API keys are required.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes, you can customize the colors (background, primary, secondary) and the title text through the WordPress Customizer.

Where can I display the AI block?

You can choose to display the block at the top of articles, at the bottom or both.

Can I disable certain AI services?

Yes, you can enable or disable each AI service individually through the Customizer.
